verses.ar: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ سَنَةً سَافَرَ إِلَى بُصْرَى فِي تِجَارَةٍ لِخَدِيجَةَ الْغَنِيَّةْ ۞ وَمَعَهُ غُلَامُهَا مَيْسَرَةُ يَخْدِمُهُ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ وَيَقُومُ بِمَا عَنَاهْ ۞ وَنَزَلَ تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ لَدَى صَوْمَعَةِ نُسْطُورَ رَاهِبِ النَّصْرَانِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-lammā balagha ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama khamsan wa-ʿishrīna sanatan sāfara ilā Buṣrā fī tijāratin li-Khadījata l-ghaniyyah, wa-maʿahu ghulāmuhā Maysaratu yakhdimuhu ʿalayhi ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu wa-yaqūmu bi-mā ʿanāh, wa-nazala taḥta shajaratin ladā ṣawmaʿati Nusṭūra rāhibi n-naṣrāniyyah.
verses.en: When he, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, reached twenty-five years of age, he travelled to Busra on a trading journey for the wealthy Khadijah. Accompanying him was her servant Maysarah, who served him, prayers and peace be upon him, and attended to his needs. He stopped beneath a tree near the hermitage of Nustur, a Christian monk.

verses.ar: فَعَرَفَهُ الرَّاهِبُ إِذْ مَالَ إِلَيْهِ ظِلُّهَا الْوَارِفُ وَآوَاهْ ۞ وَقَالَ: مَا نَزَلَ تَحْتَ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ قَطُّ إِلَّا نَبِيٌّ ذُو صِفَاتٍ نَقِيَّةْ ۞ وَرَسُولٌ قَدْ خَصَّهُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى بِالْفَضَائِلِ وَحَبَاهْ ۞ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِمَيْسَرَةَ : أَفِي عَيْنَيْهِ حُمْرَةٌ؟ اسْتِظْهَارًا لِلْعَلَامَةِ الْخَفِيَّةْ ۞ فَأَجَابَهُ بِنَعَمْ فَحَقَّ لَدَيْهِ مَا ظَنَّهُ فِيهِ وَتَوَخَّاهْ
verses.tr: Fa-ʿarafahu r-rāhibu idh māla ilayhi ẓilluha l-wārifu wa-āwāh, wa-qāla: mā nazala taḥta hādhihi sh-shajarati qaṭṭu illā nabiyyun dhū ṣifātin naqiyyah, wa-rasūlun qad khaṣṣahu Llāhu taʿālā bi-l-faḍā'ili wa-ḥabāh, thumma qāla li-Maysarata: afī ʿaynayhi ḥumratun, istiẓhāran li-l-ʿalāmati l-khafiyyah, fa-ajābahu bi-naʿam fa-ḥaqqa ladayhi mā ẓannahu fīhi wa-tawakhkhāh.
verses.en: The monk recognised him when the tree’s ample shade inclined towards him and sheltered him, and said, “None has ever rested beneath this tree except a Prophet of pure qualities and a Messenger whom Allah Most High has specially endowed and favoured with virtues.” Then he asked Maysarah, “Is there redness in his eyes?”, seeking to confirm the hidden sign. Maysarah replied, “Yes,” and thus what he had suspected and sought to confirm about him was established in his mind.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ لِمَيْسَرَةَ: لَا تُفَارِقْهُ وَكُنْ مَعَهُ بِصِدْقِ عَزْمٍ وَحُسْنِ طَوِيَّةْ ۞ فَإِنَّهُ مِمَّنْ أَكْرَمَهُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى بِالنُّبُوَّةِ وَاجْتَبَاهْ ۞ ثُمَّ عَادَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَرَأَتْهُ خَدِيجَةُ مُقْبِلًا وَهِيَ بَيْنَ نِسْوَةٍ فِي عُلِّيَّةْ ۞ وَمَلَكَانِ عَلٰى رَأْسِهِ الشَّرِيفِ مِنْ وَهَجِ الشَّمْسِ قَدْ أَظَلَّاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-qāla li-Maysarata: lā tufāriqhu wa-kun maʿahu bi-ṣidqi ʿazmin wa-ḥusni ṭawiyyah, fa-innahu mimman akramahu Llāhu taʿālā bi-n-nubuwwati wa-jtabāh, thumma ʿāda ilā Makkata fara'athu Khadījatu muqbilan wa-hiya bayna niswatin fī ʿulliyyah, wa-malakāni ʿalā ra'sihi sh-sharīfi min wahaji sh-shamsi qad aẓallāh.
verses.en: And he said to Maysarah, “Do not leave him, and remain with him with sincere resolve and a good heart, for he is among those whom Allah Most High has honoured with Prophethood and chosen.” Then he returned to Makkah, and Khadijah saw him approaching while she was among a group of women in an upper chamber, with two angels shading his noble head from the blazing heat of the sun.

verses.ar: وَأَخْبَرَهَا مَيْسَرَةُ بِأَنَّهُ رَأَى ذَلِكَ فِي السَّفَرِ كُلِّهِ وَبِمَا قَالَهُ الرَّاهِبُ وَأَوْدَعَهُ لَدَيْهِ مِنَ الْوَصِيَّةْ ۞ وَضَاعَفَ اللّٰهُ فِي تِلْكَ التِّجَارَةِ رِبْحَهَا وَنَمَّاهْ ۞ فَبَانَ لِخَدِيجَةَ بِمَا رَأَتْ وَمَا سَمِعَتْ أَنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللّٰهِ تَعَالَى إِلَى الْبَرِيَّةْ ۞ الَّذِي خَصَّهُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى بِقُرْبِهِ وَاصْطَفَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-akhbarahā Maysaratu bi-annahu ra'ā dhālika fī s-safari kullihi wa-bi-mā qālahu r-rāhibu wa-awdaʿahu ladayhi mina l-waṣiyyah, wa-ḍāʿafa Llāhu fī tilka t-tijārati ribḥahā wa-nammāh, fa-bāna li-Khadījata bi-mā ra'at wa-mā samiʿat annahu rasūlu Llāhi taʿālā ilā l-bariyyah, alladhī khaṣṣahu Llāhu taʿālā bi-qurbihi wa-ṣ-ṭafāh.
verses.en: And Maysarah told her that he had witnessed this throughout the entire journey, and informed her of what the monk had said and the counsel he had entrusted to him concerning him. Allah Most High doubled the profit of that trade and caused it to increase. From what Khadijah had seen and heard, it became clear to her that he was the Messenger of Allah Most High to all creation, whom Allah Most High had specially favoured with nearness to Himself and chosen.

verses.ar: فَخَطَبَتْهُ لِنَفْسِهَا الزَّكِيَّةْ ۞ لِتَشُمَّ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ بِهِ طِيبَ رَيَّاهْ ۞ فَأَخْبَرَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَعْمَامَهُ بِمَا دَعَتْهُ إِلَيْهِ هَذِهِ الْبَرَّةُ التَّقِيَّةْ ۞ فَرَغِبُوا فِيهَا لِفَضْلٍ وَدِينٍ وَجَمَالٍ وَمَالٍ وَحَسَبٍ وَنَسَبٍ كُلٌّ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ يَهْوَاهْ ۞ وَخَطَبَ أَبُو طَالِبٍ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعْدَ أَنْ حَمِدَ اللّٰهَ بِمَحَامِدَ سَنِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Fa-khaṭabat-hu li-nafsiha z-zakiyyah, li-tashumma mina l-īmāni bihi ṭība rayyāh, fa-akhbara ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama aʿmāmahu bi-mā daʿat-hu ilayhi hādhihi l-barratu t-taqiyyah, fa-raghibū fīhā li-faḍlin wa-dīnin wa-jamālin wa-mālin wa-ḥasabin wa-nasabin kullun mina l-qawmi yahwāh, wa-khaṭaba Abū Ṭālibin wa-athnā ʿalayhi ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama baʿda an ḥamida Llāha bi-maḥāmida saniyyah.
verses.en: So she sought him in marriage for her pure self, that she might breathe the sweet fragrance of faith in him. He, may Allah send prayers and peace upon him, then informed his uncles of what this righteous and God-fearing woman had invited him to. They desired her for her virtue, religion, beauty, wealth, standing, and lineage, qualities that everyone among the people would desire. Abu Talib then delivered the marriage address and praised him, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, after praising Allah with sublime praises.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ هُوَ وَاللّٰهِ لَهُ نَبَأٌ عَظِيمٌ يُحْمَدُ فِيهِ مَسْرَاهْ ۞ فَزَوَّجَهَا مِنْهُ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ أَبُوهَا وَقِيلَ عَمُّهَا وَقِيلَ: أَخُوهَا لِسَابِقِ سَعَادَتِهَا الْأَزَلِيَّةْ ۞ وَأَوْلَدَهَا كُلَّ أَوْلَادِهِ إِلَّا الَّذِي بِاسْمِ الْخَلِيلِ سَمَّاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-qāla huwa wa-Llāhi lahu naba'un ʿaẓīmun yuḥmadu fīhi masrāh, fa-zawwajahā minhu ʿalayhi ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu abūhā wa-qīla ʿammuhā wa-qīla akhūhā li-sābiqi saʿādatiha l-azaliyyah, wa-awladahā kulla awlādihi illa lladhī bi-smi l-khalīli sammāh.
verses.en: And he said, “By Allah, he shall have a momentous destiny, and his course shall be praised therein.” Her father then gave her in marriage to him, prayers and peace be upon him, though it is also said that it was her uncle, and it is said that it was her brother, on account of the eternal happiness that had been decreed for her. She bore him all of his children except the one whom he named after the Friend of Allah, Ibrahim.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
